title: Add a database service reference solution

answer.approach: A complete response for add a database service should include: services:, image:, ports:, health-cmd.
answer.example:
jobs:
  integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: test-only
          POSTGRES_DB: app_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U test -d app_test"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - run: echo "Run integration tests after service readiness"
answer.verification: The job starts an isolated PostgreSQL service with a health check; a real test command must wait for readiness and use the service credentials only for disposable data.
